newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon Palestinians in anti-Israel demonstrations.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon Palestinians in anti-Israel demonstrations.

text.p: Thousands of Palestinians refugees in Lebanon observed a day of mourning and demonstrated on Friday after Israeli troops killed at least 50 Palestinians during clashes in the West Bank and Gaza Strip.
The protests began after Friday's Moslem noon prayers with fully-armed militants marching inside the refugee camps, raising black banners and burning the Israeli flag.
Violence in the West Bank and Gaza strip was sparked by Israel's opening on Wednesday of a tunnel in Arab East Jerusalem near Islam's third-holiest site.
